description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

TouchTronics, Inc. is seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, test, and maintain embedded firmware for its products. The role focuses on microcontroller-based firmware, hardware integration, troubleshooting, and product testing from development through production.
Software Engineer developing bare-metal/RTOS C/C++ firmware, peripheral drivers, secure device updates, and verification testing for microcontroller products

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, debug, and maintain embedded C/C++ firmware for microcontroller-based products operating on bare metal or real-time operating systems
• Develop low-level drivers and interfaces for GPIO, ADC, timers, PWM, UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, and other hardware peripherals
• Translate product requirements into reliable firmware features and solutions
• Support secure bootloaders, over-the-air (OTA) and device firmware updates (DFU), memory protection, and low-power/sleep modes
• Collaborate with electrical engineers on hardware integration, board bring-up, and technical troubleshooting
• Develop and perform unit, integration, regression, and hardware-in-the-loop testing
• Support factory programming tools, production test routines, test fixtures, and product verification processes
• Troubleshoot software issues identified during product development, manufacturing, or field operations
• Support applicable FCC compliance and automotive-standard testing
• Participate in code reviews, documentation, project planning, and continuous improvement initiatives

Requirements:
• Minimum one year of practical embedded software or firmware development experience. Relevant internships, cooperative education, or substantial hands-on projects may be considered
• Practical embedded C programming and debugging skills
• Familiarity with microcontrollers and hardware interfaces, particularly I2C, SPI, CAN, and UART
• Ability to interpret technical requirements, understand electronic circuits and schematics, and collaborate with hardware engineers
• Experience with Git or a comparable source-control system
• Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills
• A collaborative mindset and a commitment to quality

Preferred:
• Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience accepted
• Experience with ARM Cortex or PIC microcontrollers
• Experience with RTOS platforms, including FreeRTOS or Zephyr
• Familiarity with low-level drivers and board bring-up
• Experience using Microchip MPLAB X
• Experience with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) or Wi-Fi
• Knowledge of secure bootloaders, OTA/DFU, power optimization, sleep modes, or production test firmware
• Exposure to FCC compliance testing and automotive design standards
• Experience with embedded display frameworks, offline storage, threading, or performance tuning
• Familiarity with unit testing, test-driven development, or agile methodologies
